cases.title: Each credential goes to exactly one validator
cases.when: Tokens are presented: tg_ with static tokens on and off, a JWS whose iss is a tenant JWT issuer, a JWS from an unknown issuer, an opaque token with one introspection issuer, and garbage
then: tg_ (enabled): hash lookup only
JWS from a tenant issuer: JWT validation only
Opaque: introspection only
Everything else, including tg_ with static tokens off: 401 with RFC 9728 WWW-Authenticate
A failure at the chosen validator is 401 with no fallback

cases.title: The tenant comes from the endpoint, never from iss
cases.when: A valid token from tenant B's issuer is sent to tenant A's hostname
then: Tenant B's issuers are never consulted

cases.title: Existing mounted tokens without a prefix keep working
cases.when: A pre-existing static token without tg_ is presented
then: It authenticates as before

cases.title: JWT validation rules
cases.when: JWTs are presented with typ JWT, alg none, HS256, wrong aud, aud not equal to the RFC 8707 resource, exp 61 s past, nbf 61 s ahead, a replayed jti with the cache on, and an unknown kid
then: All but the unknown kid are rejected with 401
Unknown kid triggers one rate-limited JWKS refetch, then validates or rejects
typ must be at+jwt

cases.title: Introspection rules and caches
cases.when: Introspection returns active=false, wrong iss, wrong aud, expired, wrong token_type, then active; then a revocation push arrives
then: Each inactive or mismatched answer gives 401
Positive cache at most min(exp, 60 s); negative cache at most 5 s
A revocation push purges the cache
No cache acts as an offline ALLOW when introspection is down

cases.title: Two introspection issuers for one audience are refused at save
cases.when: An admin saves a second OPAQUE_INTROSPECT issuer for the same audience
then: The save is rejected with a validation error

cases.title: Each shipped template classifies recorded sample tokens
cases.when: Recorded user, service and exchange sample tokens for Entra ID, Okta, Auth0, Keycloak, Ping, Google and Introspection are classified
then: Each token yields exactly the expected profile SERVICE, DELEGATED_CLIENT or DELEGATED_EXCHANGE
Entra checks tid
Claims are read only through the validated template
Recorded sample tokens are committed per template under tool-sdk/conformance/fixtures/idp-tokens/ before the case can pass

cases.title: Zero or two matching profiles reject the token
cases.when: A custom template makes a token match no profile, then two profiles
then: 401 in both cases

cases.title: Custom templates are validated at save
cases.when: An admin saves a template with no client claim, and one whose discriminator references an unknown claim
then: Both are rejected at save

cases.title: IdP groups and roles never grant membership
cases.when: A token carries groups and roles naming an agent group the caller is not a member of
then: The caller is not treated as a member

cases.title: Nested act claims map to the chain within maximumDepth
cases.when: Exchange tokens with act nested to maximumDepth and maximumDepth+1, and one from an issuer without delegationTrusted
then: Within depth: chain recorded in RequestContext
Over depth: 401
Untrusted issuer: act is not honoured and the token is rejected
